root.label: Holei Sea Arch collapses on Hawaii Big Island

events.label: Holei Sea Arch collapses on Hawaii Big Island

slots.name: arch height
slots.sentence: The Holei Sea Arch, located in the Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, was about 90 feet (27.4 meters) high before it collapsed sometime between Sept. 23 and Sept. 27, possibly when the park was temporarily closed during Tropical Storm Nolo.

slots.name: formation age
slots.sentence: The popular tourist site was formed about 550 years ago.

slots.name: collapse date
slots.sentence: A scenic cliff on the wave-swept coast of Hawaii’s Big Island has collapsed, the National Park Service said.

slots.name: site status
slots.sentence: “Photos on social media show people entering the closed area near where the sea arch once stood, putting themselves and first responders at great risk of falling and drowning,” the NPS said.
